Final for Publication

TYPE-1 NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING CHANGE
at 4325-4341 S Halsted Street, Chicago, Illinois 60609

The applicant seeks a zoning change from RS-1 (Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District) to B2-1 (Neighborhood Mixed-Use District) to allow the development of eight (8)
new detached single-family homes on eight (8) plated lots. This application is submitted as a
Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment pursuant to §17-13-0300 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

The applicant, Danny’s Construction Group, Inc., is seeking approval of a Type-1 Map
Amendment from RS-1 to B2-1 for the property commonly known as 4325-4341 S Halsted
Street, Chicago, Illinois 60609.

The subject property consists of eight (8) plated tots, consisting of seven (7) lots
approximately 24' x 125' and one (1) lot approximately 23' x 125’, with a total site area of
approximately 23,875 square feet, as shown on the Plat of Survey and Site Plan. The proposed
development includes eight (8) new detached single-family dwelling units, one (1) home per
plated lot, as shown on the plans.

The site plan provides off-street parking at the rear of each lot, with access from the 14-
foot public alley, as shown on the Site Plan. Building elevations depict a two-story detached
single-family residence, with building height shown on the elevations at approximately 21'-4",
